choices.content: All three altitudes lie inside the triangle
The altitude to the side opposite the obtuse angle lies inside the triangle, and the other two lie outside
All three altitudes lie outside the triangle
Only one altitude lies outside the triangle

question.prompt: Are the altitudes of an obtuse triangle outside the triangle? Which of the following statements is correct?

solutions.explanation: The altitude to the side opposite the obtuse angle lies inside the triangle. The altitudes drawn from the two acute-angle vertices to the opposite sides (extended) lie outside the triangle.
